newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA to invest about 10 bln Ffr in 1997.
newsitem.headline: PSA to invest about 10 bln Ffr in 1997.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen plans to spend around 10 billion francs on industrial investment in each of the next three years, chairman Jacques Calvet said on Wednesday.

He told a news conference the amount was level with investment outlays of the past two to three years, but he added that, as unit costs had gone down, the same amount would go further. He said the figure did not include investment in training or marketing.
